capture.termination: Harness sent SIGINT to GDB. GDB stopped the inferior but remained alive; after the 8-second shutdown grace period the harness terminated GDB. No nfs_shift or GDB process remained afterward.

runtime_log.initial_event_write: EVENT_WRITE_SHD to guest GPA 0x17AF4000, endian=2, value 0x00000001 -> 0x00000003

mapping_observation.method: GDB hardware watchpoint on the physical host alias 0x217AF4000; on every hit, read the guest virtual mapping at guest_base + 0xB7AF4000.

supported: The exact-XEX retail wait reads the descriptor head through the guest virtual mapping while the PM4 worker writes the corresponding physical mapping.
All 360 watchpoint writes from 0x5 through 0x2D7 were visible with the same value through the guest virtual alias.
The descriptor head and retail queue tail advanced during repeated 0x823A0310 wait samples.
The earlier virtual-host-alias hardware watchpoint did not observe writes through the separate physical-host alias and therefore cannot support the claim that the descriptor stayed at 1.
not_proven: A visible menu, frontend transition, or offline race.
That the 0x02 predicate bit must be set in this path; it remained 0x14 while the queue continued advancing.
Correct Vulkan rendering or sustained output.
adjudication.p1_conclusion: No P1 guest-wait, event-write alias, or scheduler defect is demonstrated by this trace. The descriptor alias mismatch hypothesis is closed for this run; rendering/frontend progress remains unverified.

supersedes: evidence/xbox360_linux_retail_wait_cursor_20261025.json: bounded cursor sample interpreted without accounting for the separate physical host mapping
limits: This run has no retained pixel readback and proves no main-menu or race state.
The hardware watchpoint covered the descriptor word; it did not prove all GPU commands or all guest queue paths correct.
